40023139.author: पदार्थः
40023139.content: अवाङ्मुखम् with face downwards, अथो then, दीनम् distressed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सोमम् the moon, इव like, आप्लुतम् submerged (in sorrow), राघवम् Rama, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, हृष्टः with resolve, मधुरम् gentle, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40023139.author: Translation
40023139.content: Seeing Rama with his face downcast and distressed, like the moon submerged in sorrow, Lakshmana, with a firm resolve, spoke gentle words to him.

40023140.author: पदार्थः
40023140.content: न not, संतापम् sorrow, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, मदर्थम् for my sake, कर्तुम् to make, अर्हसि you ought, पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा bound by previous destiny, हि indeed, कालस्य of time, गतिः the course, ईदृशी such.

40023140.author: Translation
40023140.content: O mighty-armed one, you should not grieve for my sake, for such is indeed the course of time, bound by preordained destiny.

40023141.author: पदार्थः
40023141.content: जहि kill/abandon, माम् me, सौम्य O gentle one, विस्रब्धम् confidently, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, परिपालय fulfill, हीनप्रतिज्ञाः those who fail in their vows, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, प्रयान्ति go, नरकम् to hell, नराः men.

40023141.author: Translation
40023141.content: O gentle one, confidently abandon me and fulfill your vow, for men who fail in their promises, O Kakutstha, go to hell.

40023142.author: पदार्थः
40023142.content: यदि if, प्रीतिः affection, महाराज O great king, यदि if, अनुग्राह्यता favor, मयि in me, जहि kill/abandon, माम् me, निर्विशङ्कः without doubt, त्वम् you, धर्मम् righteousness, वर्धय uphold, राघव O Raghava.

40023142.author: Translation
40023142.content: O great king, if there is affection and favor towards me, then abandon me without hesitation, O Raghava, and uphold your dharma.

40023143.author: पदार्थः
40023143.content: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, तथा thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, रामः Rama, प्रचलितेन्द्रियः with agitated senses, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, समुपानीय having summoned, तथैव and similarly, च and, पुरोधसम् the chief priest.

40023143.author: Translation
40023143.content: Thus spoken to by Lakshmana, Rama, with his senses greatly disturbed, summoned his ministers and similarly his chief priest.

40023144.author: पदार्थः
40023144.content: अब्रवीत् spoke, च and, तदा then, वृत्तम् the incident, तेषाम् among them, मध्ये in the midst, सः he, राघवः Rama, दुर्वासोभिगमम् the arrival of Durvasa, च and, एव also, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, तापसस्य of the ascetic, च and.

40023144.author: Translation
40023144.content: Then, in their midst, Rama recounted the incident, including the arrival of Durvasa and the ascetic's vow.

40023145.author: पदार्थः
40023145.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, सर्वे all, सोपाध्यायाः with their preceptors, समासत assembled, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, तु indeed, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40023145.author: Translation
40023145.content: Having heard that, all the ministers, along with their preceptors, assembled, and then the greatly effulgent Vasishtha spoke these words.

40023146.author: पदार्थः
40023146.content: दृष्टम् foreseen, एतत् this, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, क्षयम् destruction, ते your, रोमहर्षणम् terrifying, लक्ष्मणेन with Lakshmana, वियोगः separation, च and, तव your, राम O Rama, महायशः O greatly renowned one.

40023146.author: Translation
40023146.content: O mighty-armed and greatly renowned Rama, this terrifying destruction and your separation from Lakshmana have been foreseen.

40023147.author: पदार्थः
40023147.content: त्यज abandon, एनम् him, बलवान् powerful, कालः time/fate, मा do not, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, वृथा in vain, कृताः made; विनष्टायाम् if violated, प्रतिज्ञायाम् the vow, धर्मः righteousness, अपि even, च and, लयम् dissolution, व्रजेत् would attain.

40023147.author: Translation
40023147.content: Abandon him, for time is powerful; do not let your vow be made in vain, because if the vow is violated, even righteousness will meet its dissolution.

40023148.author: पदार्थः
40023148.content: ततः then, धर्मे righteousness, विनष्टे having been destroyed, तु indeed, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, सचराचरम् with moving and non-moving beings, सदेवर्षिगणम् with groups of gods and sages, सर्वम् all, विनश्येत् would be destroyed, तु indeed, न not, संशयः doubt.

40023148.author: Translation
40023148.content: Therefore, if righteousness is destroyed, then without a doubt, all three worlds, including all moving and non-moving beings, along with the groups of gods and sages, would also be destroyed.

40023149.author: पदार्थः
40023149.content: स that, त्वं you, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, त्रैलोक्यस्य of the three worlds, अभिपालनात् for the protection, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, विना without, च and, अद्य today, जगत् the world, स्वस्थं well, कुरुष्व make, ह indeed

40023149.author: Translation
40023149.content: O tiger among men, for the protection of the three worlds, you must now make the world stable even without Lakshmana.

40023150.author: पदार्थः
40023150.content: तेषां of them, तत्समवेतानां who were assembled there, वाक्यं the words, धर्मार्थसंहितम् endowed with righteousness and purpose, श्रुत्वा having heard, परिषदो of the assembly, मध्ये in the midst, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् spoke

40023150.author: Translation
40023150.content: Having heard the words full of righteousness and purpose from those assembled in the midst of the council, Rama spoke to Lakshmana.

40023151.author: पदार्थः
40023151.content: विसर्जये I shall abandon, त्वां you, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, मा do not, भूत् let there be, धर्मविपर्ययः a transgression of dharma, त्यागः abandonment, वधः killing, वा or, विहितः prescribed, साधूनां for the virtuous, तु but, उभयं both, समम् equal

40023151.author: Translation
40023151.content: O son of Sumitra, I shall abandon you, lest there be a transgression of dharma, for abandonment or killing is prescribed, and for the virtuous, both are considered equal.

40023152.author: पदार्थः
40023152.content: रामेण by Rama, भाषिते having been spoken, वाक्ये the words, बाष्पव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः whose senses were agitated by tears, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, त्वरितं quickly, प्रायात् departed, स्वगृहं his own house, न not, विवेश entered, ह indeed

40023152.author: Translation
40023152.content: When these words were spoken by Rama, Lakshmana, whose senses were agitated by tears, quickly departed and indeed did not enter his own house.

40023153.author: पदार्थः
40023153.content: सः he, गत्वा having gone, सरयूतीरम् to the bank of the Sarayu, उपस्पृश्य having touched water, कृताञ्जलिः having made an anjali, निगृह्य having restrained, सर्वस्रोतांसि all the streams (of his senses/life-breaths), निःश्वासं breath, न not, मुमोच released, ह indeed

40023153.author: Translation
40023153.content: Having gone to the bank of the Sarayu, he performed ritual purification, folded his hands in reverence, and restraining all his vital breaths, he indeed did not release a single exhalation.

40023154.author: पदार्थः
40023154.content: अनिःश्वसन्तं not breathing, युक्तं absorbed, तं him, सशक्राः with Indra, साप्सरोगणाः with groups of Apsaras, देवाः gods, सर्षिगणाः with groups of sages, सर्वे all, पुष्पैरभ्यकिरन् showered with flowers, तदा then.

40023154.author: Translation
40023154.content: Then, all the gods, along with Indra, groups of Apsaras, and groups of sages, showered flowers upon him (Lakshmana), who was absorbed (in his divine form) and had ceased breathing.

40023155.author: पदार्थः
40023155.content: अदृश्यं invisible, सर्वमनुजैः to all humans, सशरीरं with his body, महाबलम् the mighty one, प्रगृह्य taking, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, शक्रः Indra, त्रिदिवं to heaven, संविवेश entered, ह indeed.

40023155.author: Translation
40023155.content: Indeed, Indra took the mighty Lakshmana, who was invisible to all humans and still in his physical body, and entered heaven.

40023156.author: पदार्थः
40023156.content: ततः then, विष्णोः of Vishnu, चतुर्भागम् the fourth part, आगतं arrived, सुरसत्तमाः the best of gods, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रमुदिताः greatly delighted, सर्वे all, अपूजयन् worshipped, समहर्षयः with the great sages.

40023156.author: Translation
40023156.content: Then, having seen the fourth part of Vishnu (Lakshmana) arrive, all the best of gods, along with the great sages, were greatly delighted and worshipped him. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षडुत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 106 ।। Thus ends the hundred and sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
